## Security, recovery and rollback

- Does the native Windows lock still work?
- Can the user still sign in with the normal Windows method?
- Stage 1 bypass/failure behavior clearly disclosed?
- What happens if UI/host/renderer crashes?
- How to exit/uninstall/restore the prior configuration?
- Any secret material exposed to logs, UI or source control?
- Any state/IPC contracts or ADR changed?

## Risks and follow-up

Separate measured Windows behavior from assumptions.
